{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out the six internal QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_filtered = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Compute number of completed orders after filtering
n_completed = len(completed_orders)

# Print both results
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue}")
print(f"Number of completed orders: {n_completed}")"}
